# @motionmox/effects

Effects that can be applied to MotionMox-based canvas components

[![NPM Downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/@motionmox/effects.svg?style=flat&color=black&label=Downloads)](https://npmcharts.com/compare/@motionmox/effects?minimal=true)

## Installation

```bash
npm install @motionmox/effects --save-exact
```

When installing a MotionMox package, make sure to align the version of all `remotion` and `@motionmox/*` packages to the same version.
Remove the `^` character from the version number to use the exact version.

## Usage

See the [documentation](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/effects/api) for more information.
